reproducibility_note: The generator assigns the four SDS count bins by set iteration; fix PYTHONHASHSEED as well as the random seed.
verification: Independently classify each eight-spore sequence by run lengths, validate four identical mitotic pairs, sum counts with exact Fraction arithmetic, and compare the generator answer formatter.
model: Use second-division segregation as a single-crossover estimate of gene-centromere distance; multiple crossovers are neglected.

artwork.ordered_asci: Exact generate_html_for_pattern(pattern, *bptools.default_color_wheel(2)) output, captured at 3x CSS size and embedded as quality-90 WebP. Six original patterns preserve all eight spores. SVG set numbers, counts, class reveals, block labels, and mitotic-pair brackets are added around the original art. Colors identify alleles and do not represent observed pigmentation.
artwork.half_weight: One single-crossover meiosis. Track centromere origin from the + and a parents; two of four meiotic products have recombinant gene-centromere combinations. Each product forms an identical mitotic pair.
artwork.map: Schematic gene-centromere genetic interval, not physical scale.
construction_references: Mastering_SVG-2018.md: viewBox and viewport in SVG
